tool_suggestions.title: User Engagement Metrics Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard for founders to analyze user engagement using swipe and match data. Present insights in an easy-to-navigate layout for quick decision-making.
features: Charts showing swipe and match trends
Alert system for low engagement periods

tool_suggestions.title: Subscription Management Interface
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design a tool for ops and support teams to oversee user subscriptions, manage renewals, and handle cancellations efficiently.
features: Searchable list of all active subscriptions
Detailed view with renewal and payment history
Filter subscriptions by status and plan type

tool_suggestions.title: Founder Connection Status Review Tool
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a tool for founders to review and manage the status of connections and matches across the platform.
features: List view of all matches with status indicators
Detailed match history and interaction logs
Action buttons for follow-up steps or reminders
Filter options by industry, location, and activity
Comment section for internal notes and communication
